title.zh: 规定将北伊罗戈省Dingras市镇Dingras中学改设为国立农业学校并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Conversion of the Dingras High School in the Municipality of Dingras, Province of Ilocos Norte, into a National Agricultural School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Conversion of the Dingras High School in the Municipality of Dingras, Province of Ilocos Norte, into a National Agricultural School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3822_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Dingras Provincial High School in the Municipality of Dingras, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby converted into a national agricultural school and shall be known as Dingras National Agricultural School. The Director of Public Schools shall promulgate, subject to the approval of the secretary of education, such rules and regulations to carry out the purposes of this Act.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the conversion, operation and maintenance of the said school for the fiscal year beginning nineteen hundred sixty-four. In subsequent years, the yearly General Appropriation Acts shall provide for its operation and maintenance.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
